output.claims_about_policy: The policy requires four elements: P1 incident, documented link to the failing service, documented scoped-access insufficiency, and either approver unavailability or break-glass preauthorization. D supplies the governing exception rule for P1 incidents when scoped access is insufficient and approval cannot be obtained within the response window.
